verdict.rationale: Docs confirm API-driven activate, suspend (pause), and permanently close card lifecycle states (docs-10,17,18,19,30), and disputes/fraud reporting API exists (docs-7,24). However there's no explicit documentation of an 'unpause' resume action, a distinct lost/stolen status flow, or a reissue-with-replacement-linked-to-original workflow. Missing for 10: explicit unpause/resume endpoint, lost-or-stolen card status API, and reissue/replacement-card linkage to original card.
